column1: # The unknown-target case, which pins what --import-ignore-errors does when a PDS label
# names a target the pipeline does not describe: the observation imports with its target
# recorded as OTHER instead of being dropped. Without the flag the same row loses its
# target entirely, so this is the one place the fallback runs at all.
# The type is named rather than the volume: which volume represents Galileo is the
# recorder's choice, and naming it here would go stale the day that choice changes.
# Galileo reads TARGET_NAME straight out of its primary index and takes the generic PDS3
# path to the fallback, which is the path this case is about.
# The replacement has to fit the column the label defines, because every field after it
# sits at a fixed offset; NOSUCHBODY is ten characters against TARGET_NAME's eleven.
